text:
Rina: quick follow-up from the streaming postmortem — we need concise owners, short timelines, and one verification checklist. postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/streaming-197799 (summary attached).

Omar: i'll take reconnect/backoff + client handshake clamp. plan: prototype capped full-jitter backoff in 5d, add reconnect_reason telemetry, rollout behind feature flag.

Felix: i'll own server-side chunking and the repro harness. initial hypothesis: KV eviction racing with final flush. i'll add a unit + integration testcase that simulates eviction mid-stream. ETA repro PR in 4d, safe-chunk implementation in 12d.

Tess: i'll own observability and canary orchestration. need per-request partial flag + request_id, and a synthetic hourly stream from 3 regions. ETA metrics in 3d, dashboard + PD rule in 9d.

Rina: concrete action items (short ids) so we can track on the remediation board:
- ACT-901: add "partial_flag" to streaming responses + per-request tags (request_id, route, model, region). owner: Tess. due: 2026-04-01
- ACT-902: repro harness for mid-stream KV eviction + tests. owner: Felix. due: 2026-03-30
- ACT-903: guarded safe-chunk flush (per-stream fence) behind feature flag. owner: Felix. due: 2026-04-10
- ACT-904: client lib: capped exponential backoff + full jitter + handshake clamp; emit reconnect_reason & attempt_count. owner: Omar. due: 2026-04-04
- ACT-905: synthetic hourly stream (3 regions) + weekly digest to #eng-runtime. owner: Tess. due: 2026-03-31
- ACT-906: canary automation + automatic rollback criteria (partial_ratio delta > 25% or partial_ratio absolute > 0.5%). owner: Rina & infra. due: 2026-04-15

Omar: small note on ACT-904 — i'll add an opt-in flag `client.backoff_v2` so existing clients are unaffected initially. also add a lightweight debug endpoint to trigger reconnect sequences for QA.

Felix: implementation note: safe-chunk will use per-stream fence tokens and `defer_final_flush()` when eviction_inflight is true. expected tail latency impact for final chunk ~10-60ms; will measure in canary.

Tess: alert thresholds suggestion: warn if partial_ratio > 0.15% for 10m -> notify #incidents; page if partial_ratio > 0.5% for 5m OR synthetic stream fails > 2 runs. @sre-bot please open PD ticket.

sre-bot: created SRE-599 for PD rule and assigned to Rina. link: https://redwood.internal/sre/SRE-599

Rina: rollback plan: staged canary in one region first, auto-rollback if partials spike beyond thresholds. infra will ensure a quick toggle to disable safe-chunk and client flag. ops, please add rollback docs in each PR.

Tess: i'll prepare the canary checklist: (1) run synthetic streams from 3 regions (2) verify partial_ratio by route/model (3) check p99 latency delta (4) confirm reconnect_count stable.

Felix: opening repro PR today and will tag Omar for client interplay tests.

Omar: i'll post a short design doc and sample backoff snippet in the PR: `delay = min(max_backoff, base * 2**attempt) * rand()`

Rina: weekly sync on remediation status: Mon 08:30 PST starting 2026-03-30. please update ACT tickets with progress & blockers before the meeting. closing for now; reopen if blockers. :white_check_mark:
